expert_base: improved A* + cost-matrix allocation in main copy.py (not modified)

imitation_learning.takeaway: Policy clones expert trajectories well on wait/forward; turns are rare and need rebalancing.

neural_heuristic.takeaway: Cost regression converges, but naive plug-in neural h does not reduce expansions; residual/focal search needed.

conflict_prediction.takeaway: Local spatio-temporal CNN predicts injected vertex/swap conflicts with high F1.

marl_ppo.takeaway: IL(BC)+light PPO beats random and matches/exceeds greedy on small multi-AGV nav.
